title: Hayati Pro Max Pink Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Pink Lemonade delivers a vibrant burst of citrus and berry flavours in a sparkling soda-inspired blend. Sharp Lemon soda forms the zesty base, brightened by a hint of mixed Red Berries that softens the citrus with a subtle sweetness. The result is a lively and flavour-packed vape with a tangy finish reminiscent of a cool, fizzy drink. Made with nicotine salts for smoother throat hits and rapid nicotine satisfaction, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG formulation ensures reliable flavour and discreet vapour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
